limits: Adult body proportions retained; anime face and bob are sourced components, not a new sculpture from zero.
Face is a neutral rigid-to-Head expression; blinking and lip animation are not authored.
Bob hair follows Head; no secondary hair simulation.
source-reference.glb is the pre-hair-reduction clothed assembly, not an unmasked female base.
Rendering and new character motion validation are recorded separately.
